units: mm, g, deg (internal manifest joint convention: q = firmware_deg - 90 with manifest sign)

mass_model.status: provisional-nominal — weigh the real robot and parts (NEEDS-HARDWARE)
mass_model.servo_note: MG90S nominal from manifest/robot.yaml; SG90 is about 9 g
mass_model.battery_note: S3 build pack (B0F3JB59B6, 47 g listing) at the V3 kit's battery_mount envelope — NEEDS-HARDWARE
mass_model.pla_note: solid PLA is 1.24; small upstream parts with default walls/infill assumed ~77 %

walking_rom.note: union of walk / walk_backward / turn_left / turn_right / stand / rest in manifest/motions.yaml

shell.variant_note: v3-crown = support-free ogive dome (sphere band + 45 deg cone cap) snapped onto a crown that is printed with a replacement V3 head lid (slides into the head-cover rail, rear snap latch). No screws.

acceptance.max_other_rest_depth_note: 2026-11-11: non-belly rests that need < 0.2 mm of CoM rise to leave (vs ~14 mm belly) are accepted; they appear only with the +-3 mm CoM perturbation. MuJoCo drop/recovery stay the functional check.

body.note: Loftwork V3 frame kit adapted for the APS carrier (reference/frame-and-cover_261105). Legs unchanged, hip axes at the kit datums.

electronics.name: carrier-components
electronics.note: S3 SuperMini, PCA9685 hub, LM2596, OLED, plugs inside the head; mass estimated, box only for CoM/protection

body.pla_parts_note: head-lid is replaced by crown-lid (a shell part, mass from CAD)

extra_parts.name: crown-lid minus kit lid (quick_screen estimate only)

windows.note: count 0 = closed 45-degree cone.  With 8 windows the cone was 8 struts (4 mm wide) cantilevered from the foot; they turned to spaghetti below the brace (print 2026-11-13).  The struts were also only 0.6 mm thick: build_shell's inner cone ignored its 1 mm lower start, so wall 1.3 gave 0.84 mm horizontally (fixed).  wall / wall_top are now true normal thicknesses: 0.5 mm (0.71 horizontal) and 0.6 mm (0.85, as printed before, where the fingers root and the brace bites) within wall_top_band mm under the seat; mass is bounded by the CoM-error rest check (a closed 0.85 mm cone, 15 g, failed it by 0.008 mm).

fingers.root_note: the finger starts just above the seat, on the crown wall's top (below the seat the 45-degree cone falls away from the sphere and a root there would start in mid-air)

crown.note: lid rail profile = kit head-lid.step unchanged; crown printed upright on the lid (no supports)

key.note: separate stopper key: drops through a slot in the lid's rear so its tip sits in front of the head-cover rear panel's inner top edge (x = -36.2); y = +10 keeps it clear of the centred switch and the USB plug

bayonet.note: crown tube drops through the lid (lugs through the notches) and turns 60 deg in a recess in the lid's underside: lugs end flush with the underside, so nothing hangs where the kit routes the servo ribbons (2 mm below it).

print_brace.note: print aid only (crown-print.stl): a thin cylinder from the bed to the solid band above the windows, joined by small tabs across a gap wider than a line width; snap the tabs and slide it off downwards

fit_check.note: overhang: downward-facing area whose slope from horizontal is below the part's limit (bed excluded); dome inner cap is 30 deg (print with <= 0.16 mm layers)
